dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert knowledge not typically known by a generic model: exhaustive OS/product list, exact regex for Patch Group tag values, recent 2024‑2026 feature additions (macOS support, custom repository syntax, AWS-ApplyPatchBaseline), a decision‑tree of pre‑check priority, and a heuristic matrix for ApproveAfterDays. This depth goes beyond standard documentation restatement.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific workflow: ordered pre‑checks, CONFIRM gate, snapshot before update, post‑verification steps, and exact CLI syntax. Missing are explicit error‑handling procedures (e.g., retry on CLI failure, pagination handling for describe‑patch‑baselines) and guidance for partial‑success scenarios, which keeps the procedure from being fully comprehensive.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a concrete NEVER list with clear rationales (product‑OS mismatch, missing role, UNSPECIFIED compliance, wrong document, default baseline override). Only five items are covered; additional common pitfalls (e.g., tag‑value length limits, IAM policy least‑privilege nuances) are omitted, and one item (default baseline replacement) lacks a detailed why‑it‑matters explanation.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description explains WHAT and WHEN, keywords, activation_triggers, and invocation_schema are present. The activation triggers are very broad, which could cause spurious activation, and there is no explicit "when NOT to use" clause, but overall the spec is solid enough for reliable invocation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: quick reference, mindset, pre‑flight, process, patterns, output contract, NEVER, heuristic, recent features. However, the CLI examples and full tables are long and appear early, which can overload a reader before they know whether they need that depth.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained with CONFIRM gates, pre‑checks, and snapshotting. Creative tasks like custom repository definition are less constrained (no validation of repo file syntax or size limits), but the overall calibration matches task fragility well.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (description → quick navigation → mindset → pre‑flight → process → output contract → anti‑patterns → heuristic). The structure is consistent with other CloudOps skills, aiding comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides complete CLI commands, exact output contract, and example runs that an agent can follow. Missing: explicit error‑handling guidance for CLI failures, pagination edge‑cases beyond a brief note, and guidance on retry/back‑off strategies. These gaps prevent a flawless execution plan.
